current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Partly cloudy. Low around 79, with temperatures rising to around 81 overnight. East wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Showers And Thunderstorms Likely

Mostly sunny. High near 90, with temperatures falling to around 87 in the afternoon. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.
